YJ2.rate floatFeeRate, ( CASE PUBLISH_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN CONCAT_WS('',FORMAT(CAST(FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LOWER*100 AS DECIMAl(5,2)),4) ,'~',FORMAT(CAST(FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LIMIT*100 AS DECIMAl(5,2)),4) ) ELSE FORMAT(CAST(FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE*100 AS DECIMAl(5,2)),4) END ) rateStr,

,IFNULL(SUM(trad.TRADE_AMT),0) AS issueAmt
,IFNULL(INF_FIN_PRODUCT.SEND_STATUS, '03') sendStatus ,INF_FIN_PRODUCT.SEND_REMARK sendRemark
from FIN_PRODUCT left join CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE.PRODID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PA_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY on FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_CASH_INFO on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashTypeFinProd} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashFirstTypeInt} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashSecondTypeInt}
and FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = #{branch}
left join FIN_RATE_INFO on FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_RATE_INFO.CASH_ID and FIN_RATE_INFO.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE left join REP_PROD_DECLARE on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = REP_PROD_DECLARE.REP_FINPROD_ID left join PRD_SALE_PARAM on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRD_SALE_PARAM.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID =FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = '01'
and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE=FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE
left join INF_FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID=INF_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
left join PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO on FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PRD_DESIGN_ID = PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO.PRD_DESIGN_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE on FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID = PA_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT finprod_id, vdate, CASE WHEN IS_CANCEL = 'Y' THEN (TRADE_AMT * -1) ELSE TRADE_AMT END AS TRADE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE finprod_type2 = 'F16' AND ps = 'C1' union all
SELECT finprod_id, vdate, CASE WHEN IS_CANCEL = 'Y' THEN (TRADE_AMT * -1) ELSE TRADE_AMT END AS TRADE_AMT FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE finprod_type2 = 'F16' AND ps = 'C1' )trad ON trad.finprod_id = fin_product.finprod_id AND trad.vdate = FIN_PRODUCT.vdate
LEFT JOIN (select IFNULL(PRO.P_FINPROD_ID, pro.finprod_id) finprod_id, group_concat(t.rate * 100 order by t.eff_date separator ',') rate from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO t left join fin_product pro on t.finprod_id = pro.finprod_id where pro.profit_type != '02' and t.BASE_RULE_TYPE = '02' and (t.eff_date, t.finprod_id) in (select max(eff_date), finprod_id from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO where eff_date >= pro.vdate and BASE_RULE_TYPE = '02' group by finprod_id) group by IFNULL(PRO.P_FINPROD_ID, pro.finprod_id)) YJ2 on YJ2.Finprod_Id = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodTypeProd} and FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}

FIN_PRODUCT.TERM_DAYS , PRD_SALE_PARAM.LOWEST_AMT , IFNULL(INF_FIN_PRODUCT.SEND_STATUS, '03') , INF_FIN_PRODUCT.SEND_REMARK, YJ2.rate

SELECT PTL.FINPROD_ID finProdId, PTL.ACCT_NO acctNo, PTL.CCY ccy, PTL.ACCT_TYPE acctType, STL.ACCT_NAME acctName, STL.BANK_DEP bankDep, STL.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo, STL.IN_OUT_BANK inOutBank, STL.CORR_NO corrNo, STL.LARGE_PAYNO largePayno, STL.SWIFT_CODE swiftCode, STL.BLN_AREA blnArea, STL.IS_OVERDRAW isOverdraw, PTL.REMARK remark, case when fin_product.PROFIT_TYPE= #{PROFIT_TYPE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE = #{DISPOSE_PATTERN_11,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then (select CASH_ID from STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT ,fin_product where STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.FINPROD_ID = fin_product.finprod_id and fin_product.p_finprod_id = PTL.FINPROD_ID and STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.ACCT_NO = PTL.ACCT_NO and STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.ACCT_TYPE = PTL.ACCT_TYPE and CASH_ID is not null LIMIT 1 ) else PTL.CASH_ID end feeType
FROM STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT PTL INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO STL ON PTL.ACCT_NO = STL.ACCT_NO left join fin_product on PTL.FINPROD_ID = fin_product.FINPROD_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = PTL.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
and PTL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and PTL.FINPROD_ID in (select FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND p_finprod_id is null)

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID customerId, CUSTOMER_NAME customerName, CUSTOMER_TYPE customerType, CONCAT_WS ( '', IS_ISSUER , ',' , IS_FINANCIER , ',' , IS_ASSTE_MANAGER , ',' , IS_TRUSTER , ',' , IS_GUARANTEE , ',' , IS_PLEDGOR , ',' , IS_SALER , ',' , IS_DEPOSIT_BANK , ',' , IS_INVEST_ADVISER ) customerCharater FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where 1=1
and (CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%', #{search}, '%') or CUSTOMER_NAME like concat('%', #{search}, '%'))

select * from (select t.*,f.investment_cycle from fin_open_plan t left join FIN_PRODUCT pd on t.FINPROD_ID=pd.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD f on t.FINPROD_ID=f.FINPROD_ID where t.open_vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{PtDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and t.FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by open_vdate) tp where LIMIT 1

SELECT LIMIT as sn, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MAX as investDays FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM WHERE PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MAX

select FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.BASE_RULE floatBaseRule, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.AST_VDATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, IFNULL(FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.BASE_TYPE,MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL) basicBill, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.ACCR_TYPE accrType, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.INTERVAL_RULE interValRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_END_DATE fAccrEndDate, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FIN_CASH_INFO.prod_style prodStyle, FIN_CASH_INFO.TERM_MAX investmentCycle, FIN_PRODUCT.vdate, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodid, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_TYPE rateType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE*100 rate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_ID indexId, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RESET_TYPE resetType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE effDate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.REMARK remark from (SELECT FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID, FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MAX FROM FIN_CASH_INFO JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} AND (FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} OR PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}) AND FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}) FIN_CASH_INFO , FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE, MST_FEEINFO, FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO ON FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BRANCH = 0
and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{queryDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and (FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE AND FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
order by FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID,FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE desc

select * from (select FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE dealMode, FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER prodManager, FIN_PRODUCT.issue_type issueType,
FIN_RATE_INFO.INT_TYPE rateType, FIN_RATE_INFO.RATE * 100 yield, REP_PROD_DECLARE.REP_INVESTOR_TYPE repInvestorType, FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE vdate, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE mdate, PRD_SALE_PARAM.FIRST_SALE_VDATE firstSaleVdate, PRD_SALE_PARAM.FIRST_SALE_MDATE firstSaleMdate, PRD_SALE_PARAM.TOFF_START toffStart, PRD_SALE_PARAM.SALE_MAX saleMax, PRD_SALE_PARAM.SALE_MIN saleMin, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS_REMARK issueStatusRemark, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId,
CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE.REG_CODE prodRegistCode, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.INVEST_NATURE investNature,
FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_6 prodSeries, FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_7 prodClass, PA_FIN_PRODUCT.TARGET_CUSTOMER_1 targetCustomer1, PA_FIN_PRODUCT.TARGET_CUSTOMER_2 targetCustomer2, FIN_PRODUCT.OPERATION_TYPE operationType, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROFIT_FLAG profitFlag, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.RISK_LEVEL riskLevel, IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.INVESTMENT_CYCLE,FIN_PRODUCT.TERM_DAYS) investmentCycle, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.TERM_TYPE termType,
PRD_STANDING_BOOK.BONUS_MODE payType, PRD_SALE_PARAM.CONSIGNMENT_FLAG consignmentFlag, PRD_SALE_PARAM.RAISE_AMT_PLAN raiseAmtPlan, REP_PROD_DECLARE.REP_RISK_LEVEL repRiskLevel,
PRD_STANDING_BOOK.INTPAY_PERIOD payCycle,
PRD_STANDING_BOOK.RATE rateRepYield, (case when PRD_SALE_PARAM.FIRST_SALE_VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{queryDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE >STR_TO_DATE(#{queryDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') then '新发' when (select count(1) from (select TOTLE_TRADE_ID,BUSI_TYPE,FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_TYPE2,TRADE_DATE,TRADE_STATUS,PS,TRADE_AMT,INT_AMT,SHARE_AMT,FPRICE_AMT,PRIN_AMT FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE trade_status = '01' AND is_cancel = 'N' )deal where deal.ps in ('C5','C20') and deal.finprod_id=fin_product.finprod_id)=0 then '存续' when (select MAX(deal.TRADE_DATE) from deal where deal.ps in ('C5','C20') and deal.finprod_id=fin_product.finprod_id group by deal.finprod_id) >STR_TO_DATE(#{queryDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{queryDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') then '存续' when (select MAX(deal.TRADE_DATE) from deal where deal.ps in ('C5','C20') and deal.finprod_id=fin_product.finprod_id group by deal.finprod_id) <=STR_TO_DATE(#{queryDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') then '到期' end ) durationflag,
